title: Limited Usefulness, Depending on Size/Shape of the Bread
text:
Limited Usefulness, Depending on Size/Shape of the Bread. I have been making artisan loaves of bread for over 20 years to feed my family and to share with friends and coworkers. Sandwich loaves are easy to store – put them in a plastic bag and they’ll stay soft. Baguettes and peasant loaves are another issue: those should stay crusty on the outside and when stored in plastic they soften quickly. Their odd shape also makes is awkward to store them as well. These bread savers are a solution to that. They’re not ideal but they work well enough and they seem to be made well.

The idea is simple. Instead of wrapping the loaves in plastic wrap, these rubber caps go over the end of the loaves to keep the sliced ends from getting stale while leaving the uncut end exposed to air, allowing it to remain crisp. In theory this is ideal. However, there are a couple of issues, neither are deal breakers but should be kept in mind. First, these are basically sleeves and the portion of the crust that is covered will soften. This is unavoidable but is better than having a squishy loaf. Second, these are not one-size-fits all. They are stretchy and will fit over the ends of most peasant loaves, but they will not fit over a traditional baguette (they’re too large to stay on) and they will not work for large boules (wrong shape and often too small). For the average peasant loaf or Italian loaf, though, these work well enough.

I’m on the fence with these. They answer a need for keeping bread from staling on the ends, but the size and shape limits their use.

product_metadata.title: Capabunga Cap Artisan Bread Saver, Orange
features: Bread Cap keeps artisan bread fresh and extends the life of your favorite bread up to 5 days
Bread Cap protects the cut end and prevents moisture from escaping simultaneously allowing the crust to breathe
Each set has 2 sizes, one for oblong loaves like ciabatta and a larger size for rounder loaves like sourdough
Not recommended for use with "day breads" such as baguettes
Made of BPA-free silicone; easy to clean simply wash with warm, soapy water
description: With the Bread Cap Artisan Bread Saver by CapaBunga, you can extend the life of your favorite bread. No need for a bread box, the silicone bread cap is compact, space saving, and easy to store. The trick to keeping a crusty loaf fresh is to keep the moisture inside while allowing the crust to do its job of protecting the inside. If you leave the cut portion exposed, the bread will dry out. If you put it in a plastic bag, the crust becomes soggy. And never, ever store Artisan bread in the refrigerator as this is the fastest way to a tasteless, stale loaf. The unique design of the Bread Cap allows the crust to "breathe" while simultaneously protecting the cut side of the loaf and preventing moisture from escaping. Available in two sizes - one for smaller loaves such as ciabatta and one for larger round loaves like sourdoughs and country loaves. The Bread Cap will prolong the life of your loaf for up to five days! Easy to clean, simply wash in warm, soapy water.
